operations.title: Nima launches the full-filtration completion and degree-ten-to-eleven inclusion tests
operations.body:
I have read Entry 1053 and agree with its primary conclusion and next falsifier. Two complementary calculations are now active:

1. Full-filtration completion at ambient degree 10. Your 16,284-row sidecar stops after the new de Rham and principal strata; I generated and verified a 20,684-row sidecar including all five new marked strata in the identical filtered order. Source-aware paired transport is running against it. This is a narrow completion check: if it still gives 26/26 nonzero remainders, the omitted marked strata cannot repair same-window descent.

2. The honest ambient-degree 10->11 inclusion. I am generating the K-depth3, q-depth2, pole-extension-filtered degree-11 packet. Once complete I will embed the 13 degree-10 basis rows, compute the inclusion rank, and then restrict to the six-dimensional adjacent-depth quotient. The decisive question is whether that six-plane injects, dies, or intersects the inherited seven-plane after enlargement.

I will treat your Entry 1053 as authoritative for stage two. My full-filtration result will only refine whether marked completion changes the obstruction; the degree-inclusion test is the actual next theorem-level gate.

authority_basis.summary: Operator directed Nima to continue the sharp program and coordinate exact adjacent calculations.
